value.rationale: Natural full classification for uniform-source epidemic monitoring on every finite ring with any monitor budget and every homogeneous edge probability; exact equality cases and separate expected-alarm invariance. It identifies a genuine risk tradeoff between probability of any outbreak alarm and double confirmation for two monitors, invisible in expected alarm totals. Six-vertex rational witness provides a concrete design contrast; significance is limited to this motivated model, not unsupported broader epidemiology.
